articleTitle: A Novel Implementation of FPGA Based Smart Vending Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: This paper represents the design and implementation of FPGA based vending machine. The whole vending machine design Verilog code verified using the VIVADO HLX 2019.1 simulator and it’s implemented on FPGA Zed board xc7z020clg484-1. Simulation result is shown in this paper for three different cases- First, when user put sufficient amount in the given slot and machine delivered the product to the user, second when user put insufficient amount in money slot and cancel the transaction in between, third vending machine doesn’t have selected product, due to this user select other product. The synthesis results i.e., percent utilization of LUT, I/O port is also shown in this paper.

articleTitle: A Blind-spot Assistance for Forklift using Ultrasonic Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: A forklift (also called lift truck, jitney, fork truck, fork hoist, and forklift truck) is a powered industrial truck used to lift and move materials over short distances. Locomotion of forklift has some blind spots and most of the time it is observed that these bind spots cause the accidents. A blind-spot assistance for forklift using an ultrasonic sensor is an idea to reduce the accidental cases caused during driving forklift. It is observed that the driver cannot see the blind spot of the forklift vehicle during locomotion. In this paper, the detection of those blind spots is made possible using an ultrasonic sensor thereby assisting the driver in safe locomotion. Implementation of ultrasonic sensor with the user interface of radar display and LED array increases the accuracy of the system, as detection of an object in the ultrasonic range will appear on radar and scaled on LED array with alarm system.

articleTitle: Enhancing Hybrid Encryption Techniques for Secured Data Processing for Small Medium Enterprises in cloud
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Cloud computing is a promising area in the field of Information Technology. Nowadays, a good amount of fast, advanced and demanding technologies are available in cloud computing for accessing, sharing, and transmitting large data over the network. Along with this growth, the existence of data hackers and attackers has also increased. Every organization always seek error free and secured data transmission over the cloud. Moreover, the users also expect their data, stored on to the cloud should be more secured, confidential, and authorized. The encrypted data stored at server and it is decrypted at client side. In this article, we proposed cryptographic mechanisms that verify the uniqueness of data stored at cloud is same as original data put by the client. Additionally, we have also explored the existing cryptographic algorithms, namely DES, AES, Paillier and Blowfish for the comparison. For evaluation and performance of an algorithm, we have considered three parameters such as, File size, Encryption time/Decryption time and Memory usage for dissimilar formats like text file, audio file, image file, video file, etc. at different configurations for individual users.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Deep Convolution Layered Machine Learning approaches for Detection of Pneumonia from Chest Radiographs
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Pneumonia is a serious illness caused by bacteria, fungi, or viruses in the alveoli of the lungs. It starts with minor irregularities and progresses to the point when one or both lungs are afflicted. In many circumstances, failure to detect it in a timely manner might result in mortality. This illness is most frequent in young children between the age group of one and five years. For medical image diagnosis, radiographs (chest x-ray images) are the most basic examination tools. In the current work, the chest radio scans were collected and fed to the deep learning models for the feature extraction. Following feature extraction, the scans were sent into a machine learning classifiers, which classified the radiographs as normal or pneumonia-infected. The obtained results verify that adoption of CNN models helps in early diagnosis of pneumonia that results in securing the life of the patient.

articleTitle: Planning Secure Consumption: Food Safety Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Agriculture is the foremost form of sustenance for all living beings on the planet. Food supply chain management is the flow of agricultural products from farms, harvesters, processing, distributing, retail and finally consumers. It is a sequence that starts from food production till final consumption. The existing traceability of the food supply chain isn’t entirely reliable and the authentic city of each stakeholder cannot be checked manually as it is a time-taking. Instead of a centralized source, a transparent and decentralized process can be adapted through Blockchain Technology to trace the food back to its source. Blockchain is a peer-to-peer network that helps keep the data in the ledger tamper-proof. It would be a way to prevent serious health risks and be versed in the origin, transport and sale of the products that consumers buy from stakeholders. In this paper, we propose a traceable food-safety with Blockchain Technology & Smart Contracts which would make it transparent and tamper-proof. Through the proposed solution, a long-lasting trust is established among the consumers and the stakeholders to make it reliable, contamination-free and traceable. The entire supply chain, right from the fields to the kitchen, will be closely monitored which leaves room for no mistakes.

articleTitle: Study and Analysis of an Approach Towards the Classification of Tooth Wear in Dentistry Using Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: In current decades, an automatic detection system in healthcare field is an emergent research area. Extensive use of machine learning and deep learning algorithms can be observed in fields of medicine. A lot of research work is done in medicine but some area of oral health care in still unexplored. The emphasis is given to this field only because it is a difficult mission, due to the shortage of precise data available in dentistry for diagnosis and prediction. In this paper, an approach towards the diagnosis, prediction, and classification of oral health diseases in dentistry is implemented and discussed with the help of machine learning techniques on the self-created dataset. Dental tooth wear is considered for evaluation with its different sub categories. Mainly tooth wear is multifactorial situation, leading to the loss of dental hard tissues. Physiological enamel wears is slow process that usually does not lead to any subjective symptoms. When situation progresses periodically, it becomes difficult to restore it to normal phase easily. So to prevent this loss experimentation is performed to diagnose, classify and predict disease at an early stage. This experimentation is done by using several machine learning algorithms and its performance evaluation is done.

articleTitle: Optical add-drop filter based on square ring resonator consisting of octagon shape core
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: In this paper, an optical add-drop filter (ADF) based on a 2D square lattice photonic crystal (PC) is designed. Band diagram of considered ADF is analyzed with Plane Wave Expansion (PWE) technique and simulations on light propagation through it have been carried out using 2D Finite Difference Time Domain (FDTD) technique. The 2D square lattice PC consists of 35*29 infinitely long circular silicon rods of refractive index 3.45 in air background. The ADF design consists of two defect waveguides Bus and Drop which are coupled to each other through a square ring consisting of an octagon shape core. The proposed ADF is a compact structure of 286.19µm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. with resonance at wavelength 1549.2nm, a bandwidth of 2 nm, a high quality factor of 774.59, and a dropping efficiency of 90%. The effect of refractive index variation (of different parts of the design) on the performance of ADF is also investigated.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of the pressure sensor based on 2D photonic crystal consisting of micro-cavity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: In this paper we design and analyze a photonic crystal (PhC) based pressure sensor. 2D hexagonal lattice having infinitely long circular silicon rods of refractive index 3.5 in air background has been considered here. There are two photonic crystal waveguides (PCWs) and a micro cavity in between in the design. The micro-cavity offers maximum coupling between two PCWs at resonant wavelength. The resonant wavelength suffers shift on application of pressure and hence, pressure can be sensed. We use Plane Wave Expansion (PWE) technique to analyze the band structure and 2D Finite Difference Time Domain (FDTD) technique to simulate light propagation in the considered design. Simulation results show that proposed sensor can operate in the pressure range of 0 GPa- 11 GPa with sensitivity of 7.53 nm/GPa.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Adaptive Controller of DC Electric Drive for Reduced Torque and Current Ripples
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning-based intelligent control algorithms are replacing traditional control algorithms due to their adopting and self-learning capabilities. The DC-DC Buck converter fed DC motor has a wide variety of applications from household appliances to industry level. Conventionally, the proportional-integral controller is widely used to optimally control the speed of DC-DC Buck converter fed DC Motor but the performance deteriorates for parameters changes which lead to increase ripples in torque and current. The demanding task is to control the electric drives for mitigated ripple content in speed operation. This work proposes a new adaptive controller based on deep reinforcement learning (DRL) to mitigate those problems. The simulation results are illustrating that the Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) algorithm performs superior to the PI controller under parameter changes and also proving that the DDPG making the system stable where the PI fails to stabilize it for a wider range of parameter changes.

articleTitle: Estimation of soil moisture from GPR data using artificial neural networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Soil moisture estimation is essential for understanding the water cycle and its impact on weather and climate. GPR based soil moisture estimation is non-invasive in nature and provides quicker results as compared to standard laboratory approaches. Deep learning algorithms have been shown to be an effective method for extracting characteristics from GPR data. To assess soil moisture, this paper offers a deep artificial neural network (ANN) model. The data set was created using finite-difference-time-domain (FDTD) simulation and is used to train and validate the ANN model. The suggested model predicts soil moisture from GPR A-Scans well, with R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> = 0.998 and mean average percentage error (MAPE) of 1.23.

articleTitle: Classification of Protein sequences using hybrid Recurrent Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: It is evident that protein databases are enriched with over several million entries of protein sequences with a significantly wide variety of individual protein functional domains. To add a significant contribution towards this research path, we propose supervised learning-based hybrid recurrent deep learning models by combining Convolutional Neural Network and with Long Short Term Memory (CNN-LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit (CNN-GRU) into the learning architecture for protein sequence classification task with better performance. The proposed hybrid models are equipped to extract the features of neighboring amino acids with CNN module and extract sequential information of amino acid sequence with LSTM or GRU modules. The hybrid CNN-LSTM and CNN-GRU models exhibit high performance in terms of high training accuracy score of 97.5 %. The proposed model exhibits high performance comparatively with a high Receiver Operating Curve (ROC) Area Under Curve (AUC) score of 0.995 with less computational complexity elapsing for 2100 seconds to complete training process.

articleTitle: Performance Investigation Of Extended Vertical Double Gate Tunnel Field Effect Transistor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: The Extended silicon vertical tunnel field-effect transistor (ESiVDG TFET) is fascinating device at nanometer regime. This article presents DC, AC parameter analysis and a comparison is made with conventional vertical silicon dual metal gate (VSiDMG TFET) in terms of transfer characteristics, output characteristics, transconductance. Moreover, transconductance of 0.4mS/μm, cut-off frequency of 80 GHz and gain-bandwidth-product of 15 GHz is obtained by the proposed device with high ION/ IOFF ratio (~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup>) and it is self-evident that estimating linearity is necessary for determining the device's spectrum of use. As a result, linearity index is calculated in terms of VIP3, IMD3, and IIP3. An impressive result showed by ESiVDG TFET allowing it to be used in low-power applications.

articleTitle: Disease Detection In Plant Leaves Using Deep Learning Models: AlexNet And GoogLeNet
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: In this work, we created a plant disease detection system with the help of deep learning technology that automatically detects the symptoms displayed on the leaves of the potato plant. The methodology evaluates symptoms present on the leaflet and anticipates the type of sickness encountered on the plant based on the classification stated in the dataset. The latest development of the deep learning based convolutional neural network (CNN) has vastly enhanced the accuracy of image classification. Driven by CNN's success in image classification, this paper is based on the deep learning models for detecting plant diseases like early blight and late blight. The study employs advanced CNN models like AlexNet and GoogLeNet. The AlexNet and GoogLeNet models were trained and tested on data sets collected from the kaggel website. Training, testing, and experimental results show that the proposed technique can realise and achieve the highest accuracy of 98.5185%.

articleTitle: Hybrid Security Mechanism to Enhance the Security and Performance of IoT System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Research has centred on the security of IoT system by orchestrating cryptography, packet filtering, user defined port and packet compression mechanism. It has been espied that there have been numerous researches that have posed security by making use of cryptography approach. But this approach is not checking the intruders or unauthentic data transmission. It only safeguards the data from getting into wrong hands. It makes data non comprehensible for unauthorized person but could not protect it from being ruined or altered. On other hand packet filtering and IP filtering has deterred such intruders but cryptography was overlooked. Some researchers did integrate aforementioned approaches but the overall performance was degraded. One of the major reasons for the reduction of performance is that a lot of time is consumed in transmission of data when cryptographic and packet filtering operations are performed together. Thus, the proposed research is making use of packet compression technique along with packet filter and cryptographic approach. Moreover, adding an extra layer of security, the proposed work made use of user defined ports because predefined ports might be accountable for unsecure transmissions.

articleTitle: Fractional Vasicek Model in Financial Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a fractional Vasicek model with Riemann-Liouville fractional derivative, which is not discussed in the literature. A systematic investigation is presented to derive an exact solution of the classical and fractional Vasicek model using the invariant subspace method. Using the obtained invariant subspace, we constructed an exact solution in terms of the Mittag-Leffler function. The derived exact solution and the effect of time-fractional order α are shown graphically.

articleTitle: Mental Workload Classification for Multitasking Test using Electroencephalogram Signal
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Mental Workload (MWL) can be explained as how much mental resource is required to perform any task. The measurement of mental workload can help to reduce mental fatigue, stress, anxiety, etc. MWL is playing a major role in the Education, Driving, Air traffic Control and Healthcare system. In this paper, several time-domain features are calculated on the dataset to classify the workload. The workload is classified as low mental workload or high mental workload based on the rating after completion of the mental task by different subjects. The dataset consists of Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals that are recorded during the mental task performed by subjects. EEG data were recorded from 14 channels by emotive epoch device. Support Vector Machine (SVM) with Radial Basis Function (RBF), Linear, Sigmoid and Poly kernels is used to classify the levels of mental workload. SVM is applied on each feature to calculate the performance measure. The mental workload is classified with 88.88 % accuracy by SVM with linear kernel.

articleTitle: IoT Based Intrusion Detection System for Criminal Data Analysis in Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: In today's time, crime has increased a lot and if the crime is identified in the right time and informed to the police or the government, then IoT and computer applications like IDS are blessing of digital technology and are used to find criminal information, and it helps the police to get data. Right Information will be received on time. We have developed IoT based sensor. In first section of our work literature survey on network intrusion detection system has been discussed. Various mechanism of intrusion detection system and kinds of intrusion detection system are discussed in detailed. Criminal scene is captured through image auction and it is used in IoT based system. Working model has been discussed in further steps and it is a real time model which is tested and implemented in Raipur tikrapare police station.

articleTitle: Improving Robustness of Logistic Regression under Label Noise
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Administered classification of remotely detected pictures could be a classical strategy to overhaul topographic geospatial databases. The assignment requires preparing information within the shape of picture information with known course names, whose era is time-consuming. To maintain a strategic distance from this issue one can utilize the names from the obsolete database for preparing. As a few of these labels may be off-base due to changes in arrival cover, one should utilize preparing procedures that can adapt with off-base course names within the preparing information. In this paper, the class labels in the training data are commonly assumed to be perfectly accurate. This is not always a justified assumption. Annotators may have made mistakes for example, because the analysis is not obvious or because the annotator is not an expert on the task. It is possible to reduce the impact of labeling mistakes by changing the assumptions the classifier makes. This we explore one way to extend a multiclass logistic regression classifier to account for class-dependent label noise. The vigorous relapse show is assessed on the iris dataset with included manufactured name commotion.

articleTitle: Transforming Ontology from CSV file and Relational Databases: A Methodology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Today every organization creates and uses relational database (RDatabase) to manage the requirements of its users. The two ways to retrieve data from these databases may include 1. SQL and 2. Through interface provided to user. The vision of semantic web is possible in true sense by transforming Ontology from RDatabase. First a detailed comparison is elaborated between RDatabase and Ontology. Secondly, different ways to create ontology are discussed. The rules used for transforming Databases to ontologies are based on resemblance among constructs of RDatabase and OWL 2. This resemblance is summarized next in the subsequent text and a method is proposed to define ontology by constructing RDatabase from csv file and using it to construct domain Ontology which can be used for personalised recommendation.

Author Keywords: Relational Database and OWL DL Construct

articleTitle: Automatic Shopping Cart System using ZigBee Technology and RFID Module
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: In every city of our country, we see a vast hurry in malls. This increases so with great discounts on items. Now a day, people do have not much time to go daily shopping. Therefore, they buy things in bulk do for carrying that many of items we need a trolley or a cart so the proposed design of the cart is to make life easy so that usually after a complete purchase we go to the counter for the billing process. The cashier has a barcode reader on his desk the cashier makes a bill which is a time-consuming process and to reach that billing desk you have to stand in a long line. This design of our p showing a sight of installing a set-up in the shopping malls and stores to get the better of the above problem. To achieve this, all items offered for sale must have an RFID tag, and all cards should include an RFID reader and LCD screen. Therefore, the price is added to the total amount to be paid. If we desire to detach a product from the cart, you can take out the product and the amount of that individual item is taken from the total amount and the same detail passes to the flash magic payment software using ZigBee technology. So, the charge is made on the trolley, thus saving a lot of time.

articleTitle: Rail-to-Rail, Reconfigurable Subthreshold Bulk-Driven OTA Based on Flipped Voltage Follower for Biomedical Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: This paper addresses flipped voltage follower (FVF) based two-stage low power cascode compensated operational transconductance amplifier (OTA), functioning in the sub-threshold region. This circuit utilizes a bulk-driven source degenerated along with partial positive feedback (PPF) in (FVF) differential pair of the core circuit, ensures rail-to-rail operation at both input/output, and also enhances the effective bulk transconductance of the core. The proposed OTA uses cascode frequency compensation technique rather than Miller single capacitor compensation to improve the stability and gain bandwidth. This circuit of OTA is operated at a single 0.5V supply voltage and consumes only 100.2nW power to provide about 100 dB entire gain and 17.874 kHz gain-bandwidth product and also produces a high CMRR of 132.1dB. Simulation of the proposed circuit is executed through Cadence Virtuoso software tool using UMC 180nm CMOS process technology. The presented OTA results in low input-referred noise, which is 0.9108 µV/ sqrt (Hz) at 1 kHz and consumes less power, which shows that it is appropriate for biomedical applications.

articleTitle: Implementation of Consumer Tailored Dynamic Web Layout using Customer Activity Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: With the wide use of the internet and online user acceptance of e-commerce technology, it has become essential to gain customer attention for better product sales and business progression. Developers are using different methodologies and tools to understand the customer interest acceptance of web layout design and presentation. Ease of access and generic design themes with relevant only information placement might gain wide customer acceptance, but every customer has different layout choices and different concerns related to information and the design theme. This makes it difficult for developers to prepare the generic acceptable model. This proposed system primarily aimed at detecting customer to web application event-driven intercommunication to understand the averaging of accessed sections over the period of multiple sessions. This will help understand the system user liking and disliking or the acceptance of individual sections and present customized web layout, primarily known as profile-based web layout.

articleTitle: WordNet Based Hybrid Model for Query Expansion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: An important task of the retrieval system is to maximize precision and recall value. Several methods have been introduced to achieve this goal. Query expansion is one of the methods that try to maximize the mean average precision value. The proposed method expands the original query by appending the mixture of terms retrieved from the local method (top "k" ranked initially retrieved documents) and global method respectively. FIRE 2011 adhoc English test collection has been used to evaluate the performance of the proposed method. The mean average precision of the proposed method is 0.3037. An improvement of 1.71% and 2.25% is observed with respect to the original query and BM25 model respectively.

articleTitle: Predictive Performance Analysis of Ensemble Learners on BCD Dataset
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Breast cancer disease (BCD) has now become a worldwide disease in human beings. The breast cancer cases are progressively rising especially in females. Initial detection of this disease can save a patient’s life and cost of treatment. There are many clinical diagnosis methods which are used for the detection of breast cancer. Among them supervised machine learning is a very powerful mechanism that helps in predicting the presence or absence of disease based on the laboratory test data of the patient. Presently, numerous machine learning algorithms are available for classifying the disease in patients, but the best amongst all is yet to be explored. Therefore, this research work contributes to find the outperforming model from six non-ensemble methods and four ensemble methods for breast cancer detection. This study claims AdaBoost the most stable and suitable model for BCD prediction with accuracy 97.1%, precision, recall, F1-measure and AUC 95.91 %.

articleTitle: An Elephant Identification by Trunk Using Digital Image Processing in Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: On this earth Human and animals have friendly relations. As human has entered the home of animal and started misusing them, this relationship has been unpleasant. Elephant and human relations are also been disturbed. Technology has helped a lot in the identification of elephants. Image processing and deep learning are majorly used for Our work is based on elephant identification. This work is related to various images of elephant body parts. We have used CNN Classifier of Deep learning to train and test our dataset. In the first section of our work, we have given the introduction of elephants, digital image processing, and an elephant trunk. In the second section methodology and dataset have been discussed. In the third section, results are given and discussions have been made. Lastly, the conclusion and future work. Our work gives 98% accuracy.

articleTitle: A Steady State Analysis of Tri-Cum Biseries Feedback Queue Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: This paper presents a system of tri-cum biseries feedback queue models linked with a common server. The arrival of customers follows a Poisson distribution with the facility of at most two visits to any of the servers. If any customer is unsatisfied or any job required feedback then he may revisit the system for satisfaction. A customer will enter the system or exit the system with different probabilities in every visit. Various queue parameters are computed with the help of generating function technique and other statistical methods. The implementation of the model in a practical situation has also been studied. Validation study of the model is done with the help of a numerical and particular case.

articleTitle: Thermal Nostril Tracking Using YOLOv4-Tiny
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: The respiration rate (RR) is an essential parameter to ascertain human health. However, the existing methods of RR measurement are contact-based and have many drawbacks. In the proposed work, the breathing signals (BS) are acquired by plotting the variation in the temperature across the nostrils using infrared thermography (IRT). The acquired BS are filtered using a digital Savitzky-Golay (SG) filter, and the impact of the filter’s frame length on the signal’s SNR is evaluated. Further, ‘You Only Look Once (YOLOv4-tiny)’, a deep-learning-based, and extremely fast object detector is implemented to automate nostril tracking in real-time. Performance of YOLOv4-tiny is analyzed using the metrics like the average intersection-over-union (IoU), mean average precision (mAP), precision, recall, and the F1-score, at IoU thresholds of 0.5 and 0.75 each. For an IoU threshold of 0.5, the optimal model is observed to have 0.74 average IoU, 0.978 mAP, with precision, recall, and F1-score of 0.98 each, at the 2000<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> training iteration. While, for an IoU threshold of 0.75, the following optimal metrics are recorded at the 6000<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> training iteration–the average IoU of 0.66, mAP of 0.72, and precision, recall, and the F1-score of 0.8 each. The model generated nostril detections with an average time of 3.63 millisecond.

articleTitle: Study of Secure Communication over the 5G Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: With the newly developed technologies in communication over mobile networks we are breaking into the swiftest 5G network era. There will be different applications available in 5G era to serve the purpose for different requirements. There would be various public key cryptosystems for the different 5G network slicing. Hence security it serves us with security issues over conjunction of heterogeneous systems and needed to be taken into consideration. To make our communication secure for transmission over 5G network in the domain of isolated public key cryptosystems, here are proposed two schemes based on heterogeneous signcryption provides mutual communication over Public Key Infrastructure and Certificate Less Cryptography based environment. Our setup includes working on two heterogeneous Raspberry Pi cryptosystems to simulate the method for communication between interprocesses among various available public key cryptosystems. Moreover, quantification and analysis of performance of each scheme is to be done. Over the efficiency and security our proposed scheme is high if compared to existing schemes.

articleTitle: IWePam - Intelligent Warehouse Environmental Parameters Analysis and Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Many factors like dust, pest, loss of moisture, aging, decay, rodents, insects, fire affect the goods stored in the warehouses. In India usually, store managers are responsible for monitoring and measuring all these environmental factors manually to ensure safety. As there is manual monitoring involved, there is a chance of errors and delays. By integrating Light sensor, Air Quality sensor, Smoke sensor, Flammable gases sensor, Rain sensor, IR sensor, PIR sensor for motion detection, LDR sensor, Low-power camera sensor for thermal image sensing, humidity, and temperature sensors into the warehouse, warehouse members can detect the dust, pest, rodents, insects, chance of fire accidents inside the storage area. Intelligent warehouse environmental parameters analysis and monitoring system collects the data and it will send the data to the Blynk cloud. It will analyse the data inside the cloud. After analyzing the data, it will visualise this data onto a platform so that the warehouse managers can easily monitor and visualise the warehouse's environmental parameters and take precautions if necessary.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Model of Query Expansion using Word2Vec
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Query expansion method is one of the most popular methods to reduce the vocabulary mismatch in Information retrieval tasks. Traditional methods of query expansion that use Pseudo relevance feedback are not much efficient for document retrieval from a large collection of documents. In the proposed method we will try to minimize the vocabulary mismatch using a hybrid method of query expansion using the word embedding technique. The proposed method uses both Word2Vec and a local method to predict the expansion terms. The mean average precision of the proposed method is 0.2992. The proposed model also compares with the original query and BM25 model.

articleTitle: Fusion of Hand-Crafted and Automatically Generated features for improving the performance of COVID-19 X- ray image classification
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: In December 2019, the new disease COVID-19 was initially discovered in Wuhan, China and with a fast pace, it took over the whole world. It has impacted everyone’s health, as well as the global economy and people’s daily lives. It has become crucial that all the positive cases be detected quickly so it is possible to save other lives. Still, the lack of doctors and the lower availability of the test kits made it an arduous task. Recent research shows that radiological imaging techniques have played a valuable role in the detection of COVID-19. The use of artificial intelligence technology with radiological images can help identify the disease very accurately. Even in remote areas, it can be beneficial to overcome the shortage of doctors. This study proposed a method based on the aggregation of the extracted hand-crafted features with the automated ones. We used a his-togram of oriented gradients (HOG) for the hand-crafted features extraction. In addition, several techniques are investigated to get the deep learned features such as "DenseNet201"," Inception ResnetV2", "VGG16"," VGG19", "Inception_V3", "Resnet50", "MobileNet_V2" and "Xception" out of which "VGG19" gives optimal performance. Furthermore, for dimensionality reduction and to maintain the consistency of features, "principal component analysis (PCA)" is used. Our experiments on COVID-19 image datasets revealed that the proposed method achieves 99% classification accuracy in classifying normal and pneumonia X-ray images.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Shift Towards High-Performance Database Engines Including Autonomous Databases Using Derived Transient Objects from the Persistent at the Runtime
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Database as the organized backend support is creating the usefulness of the online applications. The structured arrangement of data plays a vital role while accessing the information quickly and easily. The next generation of databases will be an increasingly diverse array of database technologies using massive analytics and Big Data. The adaptability of the object-oriented and autonomous database is taking place for future applications based on real-time data.

articleTitle: Classification of Digital Marketing Targeted Data Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Online digital advertiser insights about advanced showcasing about their sales. Sales playing vital role in order to increase the business by applying digital marketing strategies. Digital marketing is one of the approaches to publishing about their business, products and gadgets. Business Members can utilize our particular time span to increase their business by using web-based promoting measurements such as aggregation, pointed toward saving you time when you need the most recent details for a show or report you're dealing with against a cutoff time. The existing system having drawbacks are less business, less business visualization strategy, high error rating and high time complexity. Past investigations show the further developed commutating power or force fundamentally propels granular crowd focusing on capacities. This examination researches and characterizes different AI procedures that are utilized to upgrade designated web-based publicizing. AI-based online designated promoting techniques are recognized and grouped to a great extent into three classes such as television, radio, newspaper and mouth promotion, client-driven and content-driven methodologies. The proposed AI calculation predicts information with an accuracy is 94.50 by applying neural network and linear regression techniques.

articleTitle: Dual-Mode Sinusoidal Oscillator Employing Single-Active Element and Grounded Capacitors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: This research article represents a new dual-mode sinusoidal oscillator that provides both current mode and voltage mode outputs in one configuration. The proposed new oscillator circuit utilizes a single voltage differencing transconductance amplifier (VDTA), as an active component, and grounded capacitors. To justify the design concept of the oscillator, simulations have been performed through Cadence PSPICE software along with the routine mathematics. For experimental verification, the macro model simulation of commercially available IC, LM13700 has been used.

articleTitle: Design of Retinal Ganglion and Bipolar Cell Exhibiting Near Biological Response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Neuromorphic engineering is multidisciplinary branch of biology, physics, mathematics, neuroscience, electronics engineering and computer science. Neuroscientists are working on mimicking retina, cochlea, motoring neurons etc. For the retinal systems, substantial research has been done due to which understanding of basic components, connection methods and computational processes becomes easier. There are various approaches like mathematical modeling, device modeling, circuit level and system level modeling by which retina can be mimicked. Still researchers get new challenging tasks due to new insights given by neuroscientists into retinal biological system. Due to adaptive nature of human brain, modeling of neurons and synapses is a challenging task. Generally, area, speed and power are the major tradeoffs in any VLSI (Very Large Scale Integration) circuits; however, degree of biological realism and robustness need to be considered in neuromorphic circuits. There are many research papers available in the literature related to modeling of bipolar and ganglion cells, however circuits giving near biological response are the most sought-after circuits. In this paper, spiking behaviour of combined bipolar and ganglion cell is mimicked considering novel averaging and multiplier circuit for bipolar cell, and comparator-based circuit for ganglion cell to mimic the best possible near-biological response. The circuit is implemented using TSMC 180nm technology using LTSpice.

articleTitle: An Exploring Regression Technique for Predicting the Sell Price of the Fertilizer from MP State Cooperative Marketing Federation MPSCMF Dataset
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: For the last couple of years, agriculture has become main backbone of an Indian economy and its 70% population predominantly depends on agro industry products like rice, wheat, jwar etc.. In order to meet the food grain requirements of the world, Indian agriculture is highly depended on the needs of chemical fertilizer which is being considered as an essential input to the agriculture. In this direction, predicting the sell quantity of chemical fertilizer is an important issue because most of the farmers highly depend on these fertilizers for their successful crop yield production. In the past, various conventional tools and techniques are applied on agriculture dataset. However, these tools and techniques could not be getting succeeded to achieve their goals. The regression techniques have capability to model the relationship among two or more variables and could be helpful for successful prediction. This study focus on three most prominent regression techniques like liner, multiple and logistic for predicting the sell quantity of fertilizer. Finally, experimental results had shown that logistic regression model outperformed than others in terms of error measures.

articleTitle: Utilizing Location-based Social Networking to Suggest Travel Paths and Places of Interest
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Location-based social networks (LBSN) allow users to publish their locations and offer their thoughts on interesting areas to visit. These recommendations can then be made to other users based on these viewpoints. The goal of a recommendation system is to provide lists of places and packages that closely fit the user’s preferences. There is an important feature for location networks that rewards customers for visiting their favourite POIs, such as a shopping mall or a restaurant. Recommendations are produced with the user’s desire, choice, and space-time problem or difficulty in mind. Various methods, such as the trip path planning technique, were developed to create a travel package. We created a prototype system that anticipates users’ travel needs and produces package tours with several POIs and their visiting sequence. Furthermore, this study provides the top k fascinating locations to visit. All of these recommendations are based on the users’ preferences. The experiments are carried out on well-known LSBN datasets such as Gowalla.

articleTitle: Improve the Learning Capability of Students at University Level by Using Gamification
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Since the late 20<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> century, video games have gained popularity as a good source of entertainment. Gamification is a big concept that contains game mechanics and designs combined with learning content as the educational organization these days is moving towards online teaching methods and online courses and material for their students. In this paper, we introduce the concept of gamification and determine the impact of gamification on the duration of Covid-19 scenario. The need for gamification in education helps to improve the learning capability. We took a survey by preparing a questionnaire to evaluate the performance of students before and after implementing the process of gamification in the learning process. We gave tasks according to the level of understanding of students. We found this concept of gamification is more effective at the university level. We design a structure of gamification techniques and implement it on our university students and evaluate the progress report. It is more effective in improving the understanding and learning capability of students and especially average and below-average students’ engagement and motivation for learning.

articleTitle: Dynamic Device-centric Fog Networks Architecture for Cellular Communication System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: In this research paper, we propose a device-centric fog networks communication architecture for 5G. It uses the advantages of fog computing, 5G, and having two modes of communication, named Device-centric and Network-centric. The mode selection and switching procedure are subject to the network’s performance and quality metrics during the communication. Thereafter, we introduce a relay-assisted mobility management procedure for dynamic mobile nodes over the proposed network’s architecture. To check the efficiency and effectiveness of the suggested network architecture we formulate and simulate the proposed work with high network load and node mobility, then and compare our result with the latest used cellular network (LTE) w.r.t the energy-consumption and delay. We observed that the proposed work has 55% improvement over the legacy of networks.

articleTitle: Effect of Break–Down Interval with Weightage of Jobs for Minimizing Hiring Cost in 2-Stage Flow-Shop Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: The present research presents a new heuristic strategy for minimizing hiring costs in flow-shop two-stage scheduling problem, unavailability of the machines and jobs weightage. The aim of the paper is to achieve the best possible job order to minimize the cost of hiring machines. Weights are assigned to additional jobs to show their relative importance. To further explain the algorithm, a numerical illustration is provided.

articleTitle: Solution of k-Fractional Integral Via Fixed Point Using Complex Valued Double Controlled Dislocated Metric Spaces
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: In this paper, we have presented an extended and generalized version of dislocated metric in the frame of complex valued metric space, which has been introduced as complex valued double controlled dislocated metric space. Under the suitable assumptions, common fixed point theorems have been proven in this structure. In addition to this, we provided the unique solution of k-fractional integral as an application.

Author Keywords: complex valued double controlled dislocated metric space

articleTitle: Efficient Framework for Sentiment and Pattern Analysis on Movie Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Nowadays, many social networks are available such as LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook, etc. These types of networks are based on an opinion by the people. Opinion mining predicts the result based on opinion. Opinion mining is also called Sentiment Analysis. There are various opinion mining applications like Machine Learning (ML), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Data Mining, Web Mining, Text Mining, etc. It can also be analyzed sentiment on movies data. It can predict various types of intrinsic information using movies data. Here we proposed an efficient approach for sentiment and pattern analysis on movie data. It is based on people’s ratings on movies, and it can predict the behavior of movie users.

articleTitle: Design of two-dimensional photonic crystal based optical NOT gate using square photonic crystal cavity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Using a square photonic crystal cavity,anovel design that replicates an optical NOT gate at an operating wavelength of 1. 55 μm is presented. The proposed gate has a very small footprint, measuring only a few micrometers square. The contrast ratio is 7. 69 dB , and the response time is 150 fs. The operation of the suggested device is investigated using a 2D-FDTD approach.

articleTitle: Invasive Weed optimization Algorithm Based Trained Neural Network for Cloud Malicious Threat Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Cloud dependency increases the chance of attack from various mediums, so security measures were taken in form of trust based node working, but malicious program still need to be checked. This paper has proposed a malicious session detection model that classifies session class into normal / attack. Paper has reduced the dimension of input data by Invasive weed optimization algorithm. This genetic algorithm cluster features into two class first was selected for training the model and other was rejected. For learning of session class proposed model train the multi layer neural network by selected feature values. Proposed model was tested on UNSW dataset with different count of dataset. It was obtained that proposed model has increases the true alarm as compared to other detection techniques.

articleTitle: Multiple aggregation model using Ensembles Classifier for feature selection: A Homogeneous Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: A device's substantial success is highly dependent on its users and their interaction with it. The characteristics of the user's database and a thorough understanding of their expectations are critical for developing a device that works. This entails developing a tool that utilizes a homogeneous ensemble feature selector to achieve the same or improved performance on datasets with fewer features. This feature is in support of improving the device performance. In this article, we used the Ensemble classification model for feature selection in the context of machine learning. One of the ML supervised classification models, bagging and boosting, is utilized to work on bootstrap training set samples. This generates a device and runs the user's dataset through feature selectors to get feature rankings. These ranks are then combined using various rank aggregation algorithms to determine the most important attributes in the dataset. This device implements a device that runs the user's dataset through feature selectors and returns feature ranks. These ranks are then merged with the help of various rank aggregation techniques to discover the most important qualities in the supplied dataset.

articleTitle: Improving Accuracy of crime data using K-Means and Decision Tree Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: The data is growing exponentially and the accurate data mining has become a crucial task to perform. Out of different type of data, crime data is increasing at high pace due to the immense occurrence of physical and cybercrimes in different origins of the world. Also, the accuracy in this data is quite important. There are many machine learning algorithms has been used by the researchers to achieve high accuracy. In this paper, we have shown the performance comparison of different classification and clustering techniques. We have used K-means clustering and Decision tree classification on dataset and have shown that the combination provides more accurate result as compared to the individual K-Means.

articleTitle: HOG and SIFT Transformation Algorithms for the Underwater Image Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: The information from two or more source images is combined on the basis of information per pixel by characteristic or conclusion level methods in the image fusion technique and the resultant image comes in the form of a single image. The objective of an image fusion algorithm is the integration of the superfluous and matching data gathered from the source descriptions for the formation of a more accurate picture. This image gives an improved explanation of the scene. The underwater image can be enhanced with the help of techniques of white balancing and image blending. The features are matched to carry out the image blending. In this paper, two methods namely, Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) transformation and Scale Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT) are deployed to perform the feature matching. Histogram of oriented gradients (HOG) is a feature descriptor. It is widely used in computer vision and image processing for object detection purposes. SIFT feature representation, coined by Lowe, is a technique of transforming image data into scale-invariant coordinates proportionate to local features. SIFT is based on descriptor histograms of gradients (HOGs), which are calculated in the vicinity of the detected interest points. These feature detectors and descriptors are known to be invariant for a broad spectrum of geometric and photometrical transformations of the images. The HoG and SIFT methods provide haze free images with better color contrast, sharpened features, and preserved edges.

articleTitle: Corrosion detection in mild steel using effective post processing technique for modulated thermal imaging: A numerical study
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Active thermography is a promising non-destructive testing technique for defect detection in any solid material. It is a fast, secure and contactless imaging technique. It uses thermophysical properties of material produces different thermal contrast for the defective and non-defective areas. In this paper, we utilized the capability of active thermography to detect corrosion which is a common problem in mild steel. We use digital-modulated excitation i.e. Digital frequency-modulated excitation (DFM) at Mild steel samples that contain whole and; corrosion as a defect. Further post-processing Fourier transform, correlation coefficient and time-based phase schemes are used to enhance the detection capability. We also calculate the signal to noise ratio (SNR) of these schemes and compare them. From this analysis, we found that correlation coefficient and time phase can be better post-processing schemes.

articleTitle: A Multilayer Clutch Designing and Selection of Material Using Sampling Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: To several problems identifies from previous research work related to multilayer clutch implementation. However, some articles resolved the problems of clutch layer friction. Hence proposed article is the proposed method that gives an optimization of multilayer clutch and friction coefficient. Consequently, the result and analysis section shows the proposed design in the CATIAv5 version, also gives related information using advanced data analysis software.

articleTitle: Privacy-Preserving E-voting System through Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: In conventional voting systems, achieving transparency and reliability is challenging due to the centralized environment. With the advancement in technology, electronic voting has emerged. But in E-voting also, it is essential to maintain the privacy, confidentiality and integrity of the votes and voters, which is challenging. The blockchain technology that has triggered the start of a new era in the digital world is one possible solution. The immutability property and decentralized architecture of blockchain technology make it suitable to create a robust and secure E-voting system. It helps in conducting the elections by maintaining authentication, integrity, transparency, confidentiality and non-repudiation in the system. In this paper, we have evaluated the potential and feasibility of the blockchain system for electronic voting. We have addressed all the possible limitations in the current E-voting system. Using solidity language, we have implemented a small-scale sample E-voting system as a smart contract that includes everything from hosting the election, verifying the voters and counting the votes and have deployed it on an external network. The paper also shows how Zero-Knowledge Proof can help in creating privacy-preserving secure E-voting systems.

articleTitle: Power System State Estimation and Forecasting using CNN based Hybrid Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Power System State Estimation (PSSE) uses statistical criteria, which is essential for different power system studies. As the power system involves non-linearity and complexity, the conventional state estimation techniques become computationally inefficient and give a suboptimal performance. To overcome these difficulties, this paper utilizes hybrid data-driven Deep Learning (DL) techniques for state estimation. Also, to make the system independent on measurement data, the DL models are developed by driving them with historical information of system states, thereby it enables state forecasting. To deal with the complexity of data, the models Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) network are hybridized for estimating the states from measurement data. Similarly, the hybrid CNN and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model is developed for state forecasting. The performance of the hybrid models is compared with individual models such as CNN, MLP for state estimation and CNN, RNN, LSTM for state forecasting. In this work, the IEEE 118 transmission system measurement data is considered for comparing the hybrid models with individual deep learning models. Numerical results indicate that the hybrid Convolutional MLP (CMLP) model performs better for mapping measurement data with states and in the case of state forecasting, the hybrid Convolutional LSTM (CLSTM) model provides better performance compared to individual models.

articleTitle: Predictive Model Based on Supervised Machine Learning for Heart Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Nowadays, heart disease has become a very common disease in human beings. Due to the rapidly increasing number of heart disease cases, it has now become inevitable to have some efficient and accurate mechanism that can detect heart disease early in patients. Although various heart disease diagnosis methods are available in modern medical science, these methods are very costly and involve a lot of analysis of the test results obtained during the patients’ health examinations. To ease the heart disease diagnosis process, there exist several supervised machine learning techniques which can predict heart disease in patients based on laboratory test data. Prediction technique that is the most efficient, accurate, and suitable over the heart disease dataset for prediction is still required to be explored. So, this research contribution focuses on identifying the potential predictive model based on supervised machine learning suitable in the prediction of heart disease over the heart disease dataset. The proposed work found Logistic Regression to be the promising predictive model with classification accuracy 85.3 %, F1- Score 80%, Precision 82.6%, and recall 85.3%.

articleTitle: Detection of SQL Injection attack Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Many software systems had a web component, and that web-based component, or web application, was accessible to the general public over the Internet. It is vulnerable to attack by the adversary. It is not uncommon for web and mobile applications to have a lackadaisical flaw that adversely affects their security and privacy. Database vulnerability attacks are becoming more common and harmful. It is critical to understand software defects and, more importantly, prevent these security issues. SQL injection and XSS scan the same security code, often employed in online applications developed in a weak and stable typed language. So we looked for a big point where an attacker may use a native notion or existing ways to access or hack data from the database. What kind of issue will arise if an attacker tries to make a database vulnerable by injecting SQL that affects the results.

articleTitle: A New Physiology-based Objective Mental Stress Detection Technique with Reduced Feature Set and Class Imbalanced Dataset Management
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: With the rapid changing world of work habits, social interaction, and ambitious lifestyles of society, mental stress detection assumes much importance in maintaining good quality of life. In this respect, continuous monitoring of mental stress using physiological signals can be a good solution. In this work, a new method for mental stress detection is described using two common physiological signals, viz., electrocardiogram (ECG) and galvanic skin response (GSR). The statistical feature extraction from a 10 s segment was performed by wavelet packet decomposition, followed by selection of optimum features by extremely randomized tree (ERT). For uniform training of the classifier, the dataset imbalance is adjusted with adaptive synthetic minority oversampling (ADASYN) technique followed by a multi-class random forest (RF) classifier. The proposed technique was evaluated with the WeSAD dataset to detect three-levels of mental state, viz., baseline, stress and fun. The system achieved an overall accuracy, F1-score, precision and recall of 97.08%, 0.98, 0.98 and 0.99 respectively. The results outperform published work in respect of number of sensors (signals), feature set, accuracy, and segment length for detection. The proposed technique may be extended to develop a wearable healthcare system.

articleTitle: Solar Irradiation Forecasting - Comparative Analysis of Various Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: The global energy system is transforming with the consideration of a growing population with rising living standards that will need more energy. Simultaneously, the world must find ways to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and provide sustainable energy production. As electricity is the fastest-growing part of the energy system and thus shifting to renewable energy production systems is the need of the hour. IEA reports that the Sun could be one of the largest resources for energy production for the upcoming ‘net zero goals’ of the world. Rapid decrease in the cost of installation and availability of solar radiation are major advantages for adoption, although this mode of generation of energy has a variable output which is influenced by several parameters. Hence solar energy forecasting is crucial to understand and predict the output of production, the demand of the consumers, and optimizing the dispatch of the electricity from grids to users. In this paper, we have analyzed innovative methodologies for forecasting solar energy radiation. Moreover, it provides a review and comparative analysis on various Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Probabilistic and Statistical, and Time-Series based models used for estimating solar irradiation. Each of these models have been trained and tested in different geographical regions, weather conditions, and corresponding relevant parameters, which would provide an insight on efficient model selection and optimization for predicting short and long-term solar irradiation. Further, we have discussed some challenges while forecasting solar irradiation and future research direction in this domain.

articleTitle: Improving the classification performance of breast ultrasound image using deep learning and optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Breast cancer is a common and major health concern in women across the world. Early prognosis can ensure better and cost-effective treatment thus reducing the mortality rate. In recent years researchers are proposing different models for the early prediction of breast cancer. In this paper computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) using breast ultrasound images has been proposed for multi-classification that is to classify tumors into benign, malignant, or normal. We propose a hybrid approach by combining a pre-trained Convolutional neural network (CNN) with optimization and machine learning for tumor diagnosis. The CNN pre-trained model ResNet-50 is used in this study for feature extraction, binary gray wolf optimization (BGWO) for feature selection, and classification Support vector machine (SVM). We examine two different approaches: a Transfer Learning (TL) approach and a machine learning approach and we assess their performance with and without BGWO for feature selection. There was a total of 780 images in the BUSI dataset, with 437 benign, 210 malignant, and 133 normal images. The classification accuracy and the Area under the receiver operating characteristics (AUROC) of the proposed method were 84.9% and 0.97. The computation time taken is also reduced with feature selection to 4.41 seconds from 18.275 seconds (without feature selection). Finally, when tested on the BUSI dataset, the results show that the feature selection method improves overall performance.

articleTitle: An ML Bio-inspired Model for improving Security and Speed of FHE for Cybersecurity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Fully homomorphic encryption is the scheme, which allows the users to perform arbitrary computation on encrypted data without decrypting it. Input data can be encrypt ,while the another user, without having decryption key can carry out data processing on the encrypted input. The encrypted output can be recovered by the user having the secret key. ML is one among the foremost exciting technologies that one would have ever encountered. Optimization is an important and crucial a part of machine learning, has attracted researchers attention. Applying the idea of Genetic Algorithms and Machine learning on Cipher system provides much more security for the ciphertext data. In this paper, we implement BGV Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) scheme. Then, we introduce ML based Genetic Algorithm Model to enhance security of BGV FHE.

articleTitle: Multiclass classification models for Personalized Medicine prediction based on patients Genetic Variants
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Establishing a diagnosis through genome sequencing will give potential advantages to patients. Genetic knowledge is very prominent in detecting patients' personalized disease syndrome. Hence, diagnostic sequencing is being used progressively. Various machine learning models have been used for predicting cancer categories supported by data with the genome sequence. Predicting the correct variant for patients’ diagnosis will increase the diagnostic rate. Genetic testing will disrupt many diseases like cancer and any other genetic disease. This research work aims at providing a machine learning-based model using genome data to acquire guidance towards personalized medication.

articleTitle: Experimental Proof Manifest Bilateral Blur as Outstanding Blurring Technique for CNN Based SR Models to Converge Quickly
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Image super-resolution is utilized in a variety of applications, including medical imaging, video surveillance, satelite photography and astronomy, fraud detection, real-time scene monitoring for security and others. The most recent literature encompasses a number of image low- resolution methodologies. Image processing based on CNN deep learning’s super-resolution techniques are the simplest and most resource-efficient. In contrast, the original SRCNN architecture incorporated Gaussian blur, which takes a long time to converge. This not only increases the computational cost, but it also extends the training time. As a result, we retrained SRCNN using widely available blurring and discovered that the bilateral filter outperforms the Gaussian filter. Our objective is to keep the original SRCNN functionalities while shortening training time and computational requirements. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first research of its sort, and no other study has applied this alternative blurring training on SRCNN and ranked it as the best for image super-resolution.

articleTitle: QoS Aware Resource Scheduling in LTE Network for Smart City M2M Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Machine-to-machine (M2M) communications, also referred to as machine-type communications (MTC), is the cornerstone of the Internet of Things (IoT) and refers to the communication of smart devices in mobile networks without the need for human interaction. Fourth Generation (4G) Long Term Evolution (LTE) and Long Term Evolution Advanced (LTE-A) infrastructure are now anticipated to be among the promising mobile technology for delivering direct access. This work focuses on smart city MTC. We evaluate a simulated M2M application model for smart city services and applications using intelligently networked streetlights and analyzed packet loss rate (PLR), packet delay budget (PDB), and average delay estimation for huge MTC over mobile networks. The smart streetlight is transformed into a sensor node with multiple sensors competent in gathering and conveying real-time data. Sensors and wireless connectivity are included in a smart streetlight. So every intelligent streetlight node is expected to operate several basic control system services, including mission-critical implementations with stringent requirements criteria of reliability and latency, focusing on cameras for vehicular traffic monitoring.

articleTitle: Enhancing Performance of Lazy Learner by Means of Binary Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Machine Learning is the area of Artificial Intelligence that deals with develop techniques capable of learning, that is, automatically extract knowledge underlying information. Together with statistics, it constitutes the heart of the intelligent analysis of the data. The principles followed in machine learning and in the mining of data are the same: the machine generates a model from examples and use it to solve the problem. This paper elaborates the hybrid technique K nearest neighbor-Principal Component Analysis (KNN-PCA) for classification on different data base by UCI, further this paper proposes a Binary Particle Swarm Optimization (BPSO) based attribute selection algorithm with objective of higher accuracy and lower training overhead. The experimental set up has been developed with UCI dataset using KNN lazy learner. The accuracy, precision, recall and F-score has been calculated as an evaluation parameter and result compared with BPSO optimized structure, the proposed structure claims higher accuracy the traditional approach.

articleTitle: Cyber Risk Management in Power Grid System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Rapid expansion at smart grids on conjunction with IOT devices has resulted in security flaws, allowing attackers to launch attacks for variety of reasons. IOT has played major role to control electric application anywhere from the world. Number of devices are now connected with it. It can be applied to control variety of electric application like TV, AC, geyser etc. Wireless technology can be used to control all devices where all devices are centrally connected to IOT. The basic idea of cyber risk management is to identify the type of the risk and to propose a strategy to handle the risk according to its type. Different author has proposed different method to analyse and manage cyber risk present in the power grid system. Author has used various methods and algorithms like probability response model, Ensemble prediction algorithm based on Time Series (EPABT), characteristics of protection system product, Multiarmed bandit approach and Integration of Electricity and Gas System (IEGS) method. The probability response model works according to response values of the particular risk. Probability of the risk may vary according to its type. Various methods and algorithms are used to calculate and analyse the risk present in the power grid system. EPABT works according to log types. Characteristics of protection system product get varied as per their use. Multiarmed bandit approach is worked according to the attack behaviour. The IEGS method mainly focus on the false data injection attack. This method is useful against malicious cyber-attack while using the renewable energy. After analysing the various algorithm and approaches it is found that every approach has its own advantages and disadvantages. Hence research is needed to develop a system which could be used to manage the risk in power grid system with more accuracy

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis in polished Product Based Inspections data using existing supervised machine learning approach
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: It’s believed that this online review has a significant impact on brand and sales promotions. Over the internet, different places and communities persons are connected and they share their experiences related to products and services. This information can be synchronized in a proper format and analyzed to achieve some results beneficial for business profit. Sentiment Analysis is a widely applicable technique for the same. Though in recent years many researchers have suggested ML and DL based techniques collaborating NLP for sentiment analysis, it has been still a challenging research task due to the involvement of active social communities and reviews with modified linguistics. . This paper proposes the Polished Product-Based Reviews (PPBR) technique with the aim to improve the accuracy of the end result of sentiment analysis for product reviews. The PPBR extracts the opinions written by customers in a more expressive as well as emotional manner. Going beyond the linguistic model, it accepts informal writing contents and converts it into formal form for further analyzing customer feelings with accuracy. The integrated method of cleaning the data and supervised machine learning leads to 82% accuracy as demonstrated when implemented with NLTK.

articleTitle: Load balancing Technique toward Congestion minimization in WSN-enabled-Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Nowadays, WSN is effectively using in healthcare application by means of body area network, which is senor-based wearable devices mainly utilized in health care prevention and monitoring applications. Limited resources make the WSN easily suffer from the problem of congestion, which degrade the performance of the network and hence reduced the reliability, which is most important requirement for WSN enabled healthcare. The objective of this paper is to design a routing protocol which can minimize communication delay and gain higher throughput with optimum network overhead. Proposed work present Load balancing technique toward Congestion minimization in WSN-enabled-Healthcare named LC-AOMDV mechanism. This mechanism utilizes calculation and regulation of queue length of intermediate nodes and reduced the data sending rate dynamically to avoid the congestion from the network. The proposed mechanism uses multi-hop multi-path routing and integrated into existing normal AOMDV routing protocol for efficient communications and more reliable health data delivery. The proposed work is simulated into Network Simulator 2.31 and results obtained are compared with results of existing routing technique. The results are analyzed by means of performance metrics like data/packet drops, PDR, routing overhead, throughput. Analysis shows that PDR is increased by around 4%, delay is decreased by 0.13 ms, and throughput is increased by 400 Kbps as compared to normal AOMDV. The proposed mechanism concluded and ensured that it gives better performance over existing technique and increase the reliability to transfer healthcare data.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Sentiments by Classifying the Tweets Based on COVID-19 Using Machine Learning Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: In the current scenario, almost all the countries face one of the biggest disasters in COVID-19. This paper has to analyze the tweets related to COVID 19 and discuss the various machine learning algorithms and their performance analysis on the tweets associated with COVID-19. The implemented classification algorithms are applied to classify the sentiments to predict whether they relate to COVID-19 or non-COVID-19. Ten most popular classification algorithms implemented. The Linear Support Vector Machine (LSVM) achieved the highest test accuracy in these algorithms with 90.3%. Logistic regression has performed better in recall with 96.06%, F1 score of 90.46%, ROC_AUC with 90.48%. Random forest classifier has achieved the better specificity and precision of 99.16% and 96.3%, respectively. Out of all, stochastic gradient descent (SGD) has attained better results in all the computational parameters.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches for Intrusion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Technology, Research, and Innovation for Betterment of Society (TRIBES)
abstract: Nowadays, a large amount of confidential data transmitted through various devices like mobile phones and computers, and with each new innovation in computer network technology, security issues arise more frequently, and it has become difficult to ignore this issue because intruders generate new attacks every day, we must safeguard our data from them, and Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) plays major role in that. As a result, the enhanced Intrusion Detection System was created (IDSs). Conventional intrusion detection technologies suffer from a high false-positive rates and false-negative rates, poor accuracy, and a slew of other issues. One of the issues with IDS is detecting new attacks and analyzing vast amounts of data. Deep learning is rapidly growing field that has the potential to deal with massive amounts of data. Deep learning has also been used to complete a variety of challenging projects. Deep learning is capable of governing large amounts of data and has demonstrated effective results in this area. This method is aided by its mechanism, which allows it to process enormous amounts of data quickly and accurately. Deep learning in IDS, on the other hand, has significant drawbacks. The proposed research paper will highlight how deep learning is applied in the Intrusion Detection System to improve performance, as well as a related study.
